title: ObjectIdentifier
description: Fiori object identifier and object attribute (sap.m look): bold title (optionally a link) with secondary text; "Title: value" attributes.

usage.summary: Identify a business object with a primary title and supporting identifier or attributes.
useWhen: Help users distinguish a specific business object by its name and supporting identifier.
Keep the primary identifier visible in the first table column; use ObjectAttribute for supporting title-and-value details.
Use titleActive with titleHref or onTitlePress when the primary identity navigates to object details.

avoidWhen.when: Provide a single navigation label without a supporting object identifier.
Name a page or section with heading semantics rather than identify a business object.
